title: Telemetry shipping Terraform module with lifecycle guard and health probes
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a reusable Terraform module to provision a production-grade observability stack inside customer VPCs. The module must install and configure Prometheus (remote write option), Grafana (with provisioning), an OpenTelemetry Collector deployment (OTLP receiver and exporters), and a log-shipper (Vector/FluentBit) with optional S3 archival. It should include upgrade-safe lifecycle controls: preflight validation, canary deploy toggle, drain hooks, plan gating in CI, and automated health probes for each subcomponent. The goal is a single module interface teams can use for Private deployments with opinionated defaults, safe upgrade paths, and extensible hooks for enterprise customers (KMS, custom dashboard provisioning).
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes idempotent inputs: enable_canary, otel_collector_image_tag, retention_days_metrics, log_sink_type, retention_days_logs, health_probe_timeout_seconds
Terraform plan must fail-fast with preflight checks if required IAM roles or subnet attachments are missing
Canary flow: new module version deployable to a single cell prefix (var.canary_prefix) while traffic remains on previous version; automated smoke tests validate canary before global rollout

Health probes: Prometheus /metrics, Grafana provisioning status, OTEL collector /ready and /metrics, and log sink tailing check must be implemented as Kubernetes/VM healthchecks and surfaced as Terraform provisioner outputs
Upgrade safety: state-locking, backup of Prometheus data retention settings, and graceful drain for log shippers (flush to S3) during node replacement
Module includes automated CI: terraform fmt && validate, terratest integration for a minimal E2E, and a gated publish step to our private Terraform registry
Operational outputs: prometheus_endpoint, grafana_url, otel_ingest_endpoint, log_forwarder_status_exporter metric name
Documentation: Confluence runbook with rollback steps, upgrade checklist, and playbook for common failures
Security: KMS integration for S3 archive buckets and flag to disable public Grafana exposure (must default to false)
